scenario: brand-new user: 6-field onboarding -> first DSA session
attempt_strategy: driver composes a strong attempt from the catalog entry the deterministic selector picks (optimized_approach + stated time/space complexity + one reference edge case); if attempt 1 is not a pass the driver says 'I give up' — pass, give-up and max-attempts are all acceptable terminations per the case property
key_properties: DSA session ends pass (≥80) / give-up / 3 attempts — termination observable in the record
